Show me the enterprise profile context.
For Lakeshore Holdings, here is the enterprise profile at a glance.
• **Scale is real but dispersed.** A $7.12B revenue portfolio across four named operating companies, 11,800 employees, and $190.6M in total IT spend — yet roughly half that revenue ($3.56B) remains unallocated to named entities, signaling consolidation complexity that affects every planning conversation.
• **The IT budget split is the structural tension.** Corporate IT controls only $36.5M; the remaining $154.1M sits in operating-company budgets. With just $11.8M designated for innovation, the holdco has limited direct leverage over portfolio-wide technology direction without operating-company alignment.
• **Four active initiatives are the near-term proving ground.** ERP/HCM modernization, Treasury cash visibility, Legal contract lifecycle, and Portfolio data foundation are each in motion — these are where holdco strategy meets operating-company execution risk.
Freshness and source ownership of budget and revenue figures require client validation before board use.
